description:
Decode MessagePack bytes to JSON, with the lossy edges tagged instead of silently coerced: 64-bit integers past 2^53 as {$int64}, binary as {$bytes, hex}, extensions as {$ext}, the timestamp extension as ISO-8601, non-string map keys preserved as $key entries. Trailing bytes after the first value are reported.

Returns: JSON { value, trailingBytes } — value uses $int64/$bytes/$ext/$timestamp tags where plain JSON cannot carry the original.
Example input: {"data":"82a7636f6d70616374c3a6736368656d6100"}
On error, includes hint: The msgpack.org homepage document: {"compact":true,"schema":0}.

data.description: The MessagePack bytes, hex or base64.

name: msgpack_decode
title: Decode MessagePack
